task: Add a feature to the textstats package: top_words(text, n=3, stopwords=None) in textstats/core.py, also exported from the package (textstats.top_words and listed in textstats.__all__). It returns a list of (word, count) tuples for the n most frequent words, using the existing tokenize() rules. Sort by count descending, then alphabetically for ties. stopwords is an optional collection of words to ignore, compared case-insensitively. Return fewer than n items when there are fewer distinct words. Raise ValueError when n is not positive. Write unit tests for top_words in the tests/ directory and keep every existing test passing.
